messages:
maya (PM): Quick sync — we need final cross-team alignment for the Gatework slate pilot. Customer wants prewarm + configurable fallback. Can we confirm launch criteria, infra needs, and security constraints? cc @kevin @sara @tom :eyes:

kevin (eng-runtime): Quick list of questions: what are the SLO targets (p95/p99), do we require model pinning per-tenant, and is HSM mandatory for pilot? Runtime will need model pinning if we do per-tenant dedicated pools.

maya (PM): Goal: interactive flows p95 <= 300ms, p99 <= 600ms. Embeddings/batch p95 <= 800ms. MVP can use KMS; HSM is enterprise-only post-pilot. We do want model pinning for pilot to avoid noisy neighbor regressions.

sara (infra): We can carve out dedicated pools for the pilot: suggested starting point is 2x p4d equivalents per tenant window. Network-wise we need ACLs + staging VPC peering. ETA: infra can provision once we get a formal capacity request — ~3 weeks lead.

tom (security): KMS-only for MVP is fine. If HSM is deferred, I'll still need the key-residency checklist and a threat model for the prewarm flow (how keys are used in routing). Can we get a short doc?

maya (PM): A short KMS checklist -> yes, I'll own that. Tom, do you need anything else to greenlight pilot besides the checklist + infra network config?

tom (security): Checklist + proof that prewarm doesn't leak KV caches to other tenants. Also need audit log requirements described. After infra doc is posted, I need ~3 business days to sign off.

kevin (eng-runtime): Runtime notes: prewarm will allocate KV-cache + KV prepopulation jobs. Fallback plan: auto-route to a quantized variant (Q4) or a smaller architecture. Tradeoffs: Q4 cuts cost ~2-3x, but increases hallucination risk. We'll add quality gates that trigger automatic rollback and alerting.

liam (eng-platform): Platform needs to expose three knobs in Console/API: canary_pct, prewarm_seconds, fallback_model. I'll add a route.policy object to the API:

route.policy: {
  "canary_pct": 5,
  "prewarm_seconds": 300,
  "fallback_model": "redwood-q4-small"
}

Will push a PR for the UI + API schema next week.

jen (solutions): For customers I'll prepare a recommended template: prompt-set for acceptance, traffic pattern to simulate, and target metrics (latency + quality). Can ship a starter pack that they can run against a staging tenant.

kevin (eng-runtime): Heads-up: runtime needs model weights frozen for prewarm — that will be part of the rollout checklist. Branch with prototype prewarm plumbing is feature/prewarm-rls. Quick test curl below (internal only):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/predict \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"gatework-v1","route.policy":{"prewarm_seconds":600}}'

maya (PM): OK — decisions so far: 1) Pilot uses KMS (HSM deferred to GA). 2) Pin models per-tenant for pilot. 3) Canary rollout with fallback to quantized model. 4) Infra reserves dedicated pool slots.

maya (PM): Action items (owners and rough ETA):
- Infra: post capacity request + ACL doc by EOD Friday (sara)
- Runtime: complete prewarm + fallback gating and add automatic rollback hooks (kevin) - PR by next Tue
- Platform: add route.policy UI + API (liam) - feature PR by next Wed
- Security: review KMS checklist + audit log requirements after infra doc (tom) - sign-off in 3 business days after docs
- Solutions: deliver prompt-set + acceptance template (jen) - deliverable by Tues
- PM: publish launch criteria doc and final scope (maya) - publish by Mon

sara (infra): I'll draft the capacity request now and link to it here when done.

tom (security): Also flagging that if customers enable private networking we need a short runbook for key rotation during prewarm windows. I'll add that item to the checklist.

kevin (eng-runtime): One more runtime note: we'll instrument a lightweight eval that runs against the canary (10 prompts) every 5m. If hallucination rate > threshold -> auto-scale down canary and notify SRE/PM.

deploy-bot: deployment status: feature/prewarm-rls CI passed -> test cluster deployed (build 2043). :white_check_mark:

maya (PM): Good. If no blockers, I'll lock model-pinning and ask infra to start provisioning tomorrow morning. Thanks everyone — will follow up with the launch criteria doc and link to infra capacity ticket. :rocket:
